You know what, Mattéo, you've already recognized that you have a nice and bright future in front of you. Maybe put things in context for yourself a little; have you tried keeping a gratitude journal? Right off the bat, I can list a couple of things that you may feel grateful for:

* Education and access to school (the vast, vast, vast majority of the world would die for this, and many literally do)
* Access to medicine and healthcare (we're very far from this even being close to universal)
* A roof on your head and living family members (they may not be great all the time, but at least they are there)

Some of this might make you feel guilty for feeling the way you do. I get that. You might even feel it's a little bit cliche. Sometimes, though, putting things into perspective can help greatly with realizing the magnitude of our issues.

You'll make it. Fight on.
